verdict.rationale: LegalZoom explicitly advertises a 'Compliance Calendar' with email reminders for annual report deadlines, alerts on official mail, and real-time compliance status notifications tied to registered agent service — directly matching the story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the calendar and reminders work reliably in practice, and detail on how far in advance reminders are sent or whether other filing types (not just annual reports) are covered.
